name: What finishes are best for durable rental properties?

mainEntity.name: What finishes are best for durable rental properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: For rental properties, prioritize finishes that are durable, easy to clean, and resistant to wear and tear. For flooring, consider Luxury Vinyl Tile (LVT), ceramic tile, or engineered wood. For countertops, quartz or laminate offer good durability and value. Washable, semi-gloss paint is ideal for walls. Opt for robust fixtures and hardware that can withstand frequent use. These choices help minimize maintenance costs and ensure your property remains attractive for longer, reducing the need for frequent replacements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable finishes for rental properties include LVT or tile flooring, quartz or laminate countertops, washable semi-gloss paint, and robust fixtures to minimize wear and maintenance.
